name: Whitefly
symptoms: Yellowing of leaves, wilting, stunted growth, sticky residue on leaves
organicControl: Spray neem oil (3%) at 7-10 days interval
preventionTips: Use resistant varieties, maintain field hygiene, proper spacing, intercropping
description: Whiteflies are tiny insects that suck plant sap, transmitting viruses and causing stunted growth.

name: Aphid
symptoms: Curling of leaves, yellowing, sticky honeydew, sooty mold formation
organicControl: Use of beneficial insects like ladybugs
preventionTips: Avoid excessive nitrogen, use resistant varieties, timely sowing
description: Aphids are soft-bodied insects that feed on plant sap and multiply rapidly in cool weather.

name: Stem Borer
symptoms: Dead heart in seedlings, white sawdust-like frass in tunnels, ear damage
preventionTips: Timely sowing, destroy crop residue, use pheromone traps
description: Stem borers are larvae that tunnel inside plant stems, causing wilting and crop loss.

name: Powdery Mildew
symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves, premature leaf drop, reduced yield
preventionTips: Avoid crowding, maintain field hygiene, improve air circulation, use resistant varieties
description: Powdery mildew is a fungal disease causing white coating on plant leaves and reducing yield.

name: Early Blight
symptoms: Concentric rings on older leaves, yellowing, leaf spots with dark brown rings
preventionTips: Use disease-free seeds, crop rotation, avoid overhead watering, mulching
description: Early blight causes leaf spots with concentric rings and can devastate tomato and potato crops.
